prompt:
Use case: logo-brand refinement. EDIT AND DEVELOP THE SELECTED IDENTITY, not a new option. Input image is the user's chosen CropEvidence "Margin Notes" brand. Preserve its recognizably hand-drawn editorial serif character, olive/cream palette, generous counters and expressive but readable C and E. User approved a refinement to make it fit a premium B2B SaaS interface.
Output one refined identity presentation board 1536 x 1024 landscape. Title small "MARGIN NOTES / REFINED". Main focus is a LARGE HORIZONTAL wordmark exact "CropEvidence" on ONE LINE, no gap between Crop and Evidence. Use the source's organic custom serif construction, not a stock Didot substitute. Tighten kerning consistently, balance cap heights, keep strokes sturdy enough at smaller sizes. Remove the sweeping long smile-like underline entirely from horizontal wordmark. Retain a modest curved p terminal, no oversize swash; use an ordinary small round i dot for readability. Preserve personality rather than turning it into generic tech typography.
Standalone symbol: replace source's flower-over-smile with a compact editorial reference mark: ONE simple four-stroke asymmetric asterisk in upper right of an OPEN L-SHAPED ANNOTATION BRACKET, its lower horizontal line and left vertical line meeting in a gently softened 90-degree corner. Equal bold stroke weight. Empty space between bracket and asterisk. The reference point is being located, not approved. It must NOT resemble a face, flower, sprout, smile, shield, checkmark or a rounded-square app icon. Original, visually precise, still subtly hand-drawn.
Board composition: upper 50% spacious ivory hero showing main horizontal wordmark to left and standalone annotation symbol to right with a thin vertical divider. Middle left show smaller stacked source-like Crop / Evidence secondary wordmark without huge underline, same letter shapes; label "Editorial". Middle right show monochrome ivory horizontal wordmark on solid olive rectangle; label "Reverse". This is a static branding application, not proof of software. Tiny annotation "Application study". No sample numbers, analytics or operational claims.
Colors ivory #F7F4EA dark olive #39472C, pale blue #CCDFEC only as a small label background, no pink flower aesthetic. All identity repetitions consistent. Crisp flat vector-like lines with subtle optical irregularity in lettering only, no roughness/brush texture, no mock stationery, photos, metallic effects, gradients, shadows, invented taglines, or branding claims. Keep this a clear evolution of the supplied Margin Notes design. Do not show competing options.
targetedCorrection: Make ONE targeted correction to the attached CropEvidence refined identity board. Replace that element with a compact typographic reference asterisk made of THREE STRAIGHT intersecting strokes at equal 60-degree angles, SIX short straight arms with FLAT CUT ENDS, all joined at one solid center. No disconnected oval petals, no teardrops, no plant/floral feel, no smile. Keep the L-shaped annotation bracket exactly as it is and keep a gap between bracket and asterisk.
